_template_notes: TEMPLATE ONLY — not a real trap set. Replace every <REPLACE-ME> value, delete this _template_notes array, and freeze the file before buying anything.
A trap is a query whose ground truth is known in advance and independent of any provider's answer. Freeze the set before scoring begins and never tune it afterwards.
Ground truth must be checked against public chain data for each trap — never copied from a provider's answer.
intent: the Telegraph intent this set tests (e.g. ONCHAIN_TX_LOOKUP_GENERAL). Check the live catalogue for the exact intent name before using it.
chain: the chain the traps live on (TrapTest uses base-sepolia).
expected_status: confirmed | reverted | pending | not_found. The scorer rejects anything else (see traptest/traps.py).
expected_value: raw wei as a string. Say which value you mean in value_basis — tx value field vs Transfer-event amount — or the trap is unfair (see traptest/trap_design.md).
expected_block: integer block number. Leave expected_* as null ONLY when the field is genuinely unscored for that category (e.g. value on a contract call with zero tx value).
strict_unknown: set true ONLY on unknown-tx traps in a v2-style set — a not_found answer carrying any invented from/to/value/block then fails outright. Default false (v1 scoring).

provenance: required for every trap (see traptest/trap_catalog.py validate_provenance). source_url must be a real http(s) URL of the record checked; block must equal expected_block; checked_at and checker are required.

category: one of plain_transfer | token_transfer | contract_interaction | reverted_tx | multi_recipient_tx | unknown_tx for ONCHAIN_TX_LOOKUP_GENERAL. Every set must contain at least one reverted_tx and one unknown_tx (enforced by build_fixed_set).
One trap per object. Trap ids must be unique. Recommended size: 12 traps (see traptest/trap_design.md §4). Hard cap: 30 traps.
freeze_notes: <REPLACE-ME: how ground truth was checked, e.g. 'Each trap verified against the Base Sepolia public RPC (eth_getTransactionByHash + eth_getTransactionReceipt) before freezing.'>
freeze_time_utc: <REPLACE-ME: ISO-8601 UTC time when this set was frozen, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00Z>
